summary: Shopfront service strip off Moggill Road where cars and a van park.
reasons: Shops beside it, apartments 24 m away

drivers.seclusion: Shops and offices on the south side; nearest dwelling is apartments 24 m away. Open to the main road and signals.
drivers.access_and_room: Short 10 m stretch, just over a van length, next to a kerbed strip where a van and cars are parked.
drivers.traffic: Busy multi-lane arterial next to a signalised junction.
drivers.convention: Parked vehicles in the strip in both images; clearway 4-7pm Mon-Sat means no stopping then.

flags: Short: only about one van length
sun_shade: Open; building shades the south side in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the strip is signed for short stays

best_section.where: Shopfront strip beside Mr Noodle at the Moggill Road junction
